description: Reads the activity log (Everything Marsell did) for the last days, newest first: each entry's time, engine, kind, title and detail (published, scheduled, replied, ordered, signed up, contacted, decided, dropped, made), with the tokens it was charged where its work recorded them (the ledger's own count, the same the owner sees on that row). Every entry in the span, never a page of them. Use it for what happened and what it cost; what the planning passes decided is journal_read, one contact's history crm_timeline.

days.description: The span, in days back from now.

engine.description: Only one engine's entries, by its id (content, social, community, search, paid, sites, creators, convert, planner, operator and the rest); null for all.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
